corrections.before: Where invitation notifications are enabled, device registration information and notification tokens are used to route those notifications.
corrections.after: When the App registers a signed-in installation for invitation notifications, our services store its installation identifier, notification token, account association and enabled or disabled status. A registration can be stored even when notification delivery is disabled; turning notifications off does not itself erase that registration.
corrections.reason: syncOnce checks token/session, computes enabled from permission/preference, then registers regardless of false. Backend persists record before returning configured&&enabled. Signout submits enabled=false rather than deleting record.
